gitlab.link.description: Would you like to add another gitlab instance to integrate it into your automation with the help of Dulno? Just click on the logo.
gitlab.action.project.create.name: Create project
gitlab.action.project.create.description: Creates a new project in your Gitlab
gitlab.action.project.create.input.gitla: The Gitlab in which the new project is to be created
gitlab.action.project.create.input.proje: The name you want to give the project
gitlab.action.project.create.input.visib: What access the project should have
gitlab.action.project.create.output.name: Project name
gitlab.action.project.create.failure.git: An error has occurred while creating a Gitlab project. The error occurred because the Gitlab instance could not be found. Could it be that you have removed the Gitlab?
An error has occurred while creating a Gitlab project. The error occurred because the Gitlab instance could not process the request. The application may be missing an authorisation.
gitlab.action.issue.create.name: Create issue
gitlab.action.issue.create.description: Creates a new issue in your Gitlab
The Gitlab in which the new issue is to be created
gitlab.action.issue.create.input.project: The project in which the new issue is to be created
gitlab.action.issue.create.input.issue.t: The title of the new issue
gitlab.action.issue.create.input.issue.d: The description of the new issue
gitlab.action.issue.create.output.title: Issue title
gitlab.action.issue.create.failure.gitla: An error has occurred while creating a Gitlab issue. The error occurred because the Gitlab instance could not be found. Could it be that you have removed the Gitlab?
An error has occurred while creating a Gitlab issue. The error occurred because the Gitlab instance could not process the request. The application may be missing an authorisation.
